in_marathi.name: Mun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the name Mun is derived from the word for moon. It is a name that evokes the peaceful and calming energy of the lunar cycle. The moon is a symbol of stability, change, and nourishment, making this name an excellent choice for a boy who embodies these qualities.
